memories.text: 米娅，你来啦！我刚才听说学校明天可能要停课，你听到什么相关消息了吗？
memories.textEn: Mia, you're here! I just heard that school might be closed tomorrow, have you heard anything about it?

memories.text: 林朵早上好！我完全没听说这件事呢，是真的吗？大家为什么说要停课呀？我刚才还在想今天跟你好好学学冲咖啡，顺便帮忙接待新客人呢。
memories.textEn: Good morning, Lin Duo! I haven't heard anything about that at all. Is it true? Why would the school close? I was just thinking of learning coffee brewing from you today and helping greet new guests.

memories.text: 我也只是隐约听了一耳朵，具体原因还不清楚呢，说不定只是瞎传。好呀，你想学冲咖啡随时欢迎！今天正好到了批不错的豆子，我教你手冲，待会儿有街坊来咱们还能顺便问问。
memories.textEn: I only overheard a bit of it myself and don't know the reason yet—it might just be a rumor. Sure, you're welcome to learn coffee brewing! We have fresh beans today, so I'll show you pour-over and we can ask visiting neighbors.

memories.text: 太棒了！新到的豆子闻起来一定很香，我都迫不及待了。那咱们先从研磨和水温开始学起吗？正好胡歌也在附近，等冲好了还可以请大家品尝品尝！
memories.textEn: That sounds wonderful! The new beans must smell amazing, I can't wait. Shall we start with the grind size and water temp? Hugo is nearby too, so we can invite everyone to taste it once brewed!

memories.text: 林朵，关于你刚才提起的听说明天学校可能停课的事，我也很好奇具体是怎么回事呢。咱们先准备手冲咖啡的豆子和器具吧，等会儿有熟客来店里，正好顺便打听一下！
memories.textEn: Lin Duo, regarding what you mentioned earlier that school might be closed tomorrow, I'm curious too. Let's prepare the beans and gear for pour-over coffee, and we can ask around when regulars arrive!

memories.text: 没问题！咱们先把滤纸润湿温一下壶，这批浅烘的豆子研磨度要稍微偏细一点，水温大概控制在91度左右。等下冲好了，正好胡歌也在，我们可以请他一起尝尝看！
memories.textEn: Sounds great! Let's rinse the filter and warm the server first. These light roast beans need a slightly finer grind, and water temp around 91°C. Hugo is nearby too, so we can invite him to taste it once it's ready!

memories.text: 太好了，我这就把滤纸润湿温壶！91度的水温和偏细研磨我都记下了，这批浅烘豆闻起来有淡淡的花果香呢。等冲好第一壶，我就去请胡歌尝尝，顺便也认识认识他！
memories.textEn: Awesome, I'll rinse the filter and warm the server right away! Got it—91°C water and a finer grind. The beans smell delightfully floral. Once it's brewed, I'll invite Hugo to taste it and introduce myself!

memories.text: 你的嗅觉真敏锐，这正是日晒豆特有的花果香气！来，先注入三十毫升水进行闷蒸，让咖啡粉充分排气。胡歌平时常在镇上走动，消息也灵通，等会儿咱们冲好一起端过去，说不定他还能知道点学校停课的新内幕呢！
memories.textEn: You have a great nose! That floral and fruity aroma is classic for natural processed beans. Pour thirty milliliters first to let it bloom. Hugo gets around town a lot; once it's brewed, maybe he'll know something about the school rumor!
